description:
FOUND by the fz-kdt.127.2 build (type-preserving forwarder erasure), measured
base 8c3d5ce90 vs head.

fixtures2/behavior/callable_union_capture_containment.fz was written as
fz-kdt.167's WITNESS: mk/1 minted at a mailbox-typed `any` capture and at
`int`/`float` literals, all four forwarded through P.run/2, so one shared run
body had to choose by a runtime test on the construction -- and the union
construction OVERLAPS both narrow arms while being INSIDE neither. Admitting on
overlap answered 12.0 for 12 on interp and aborted in fz_closure_get_capture_f64
on the native door.

Under the brand-only forwarder erasure the program is STATIC: P.run/2 keys three
activations (`closure[?](any)`, `closure[?](int)`, `closure[?](float)`),
every callsite has one target, and the canon goes 52 questions -> 16, 1 dispatch
node -> 0, 37 executables -> 35. Output is unchanged (12 11.0 12 11.0 on all
three doors) and the CONTAINMENT LAW is still pinned at the unit level
(runtime_type_predicate.rs: contained_in / CallableShape::inside tests, and
types_test.rs). What is gone is the end-to-end witness: nothing in the corpus
now routes a union-capture construction through a real dispatch arm, so a
regression from containment back to overlap would show in no fixture.

REPRODUCER that restores it (measured at head, correct: prints 12 on interp and
JIT, 3 dispatch nodes, arms `type(closure[P.mk/1#lambda](any))` vs
`type(closure[P.mk/1#lambda](int))`) -- the closure itself must come from a
runtime branch, exactly as same_lambda_two_capture_types_dynamic does:

  defmodule P do
    fn twice(f, x), do: f.(f.(x))
    fn run(f, x), do: twice(f, x)
    fn mk(c), do: fn (n) -> n + c end
  end
  fn main() do
    send(self(), 1)
    a = receive do v -> v end
    f = case a > 0 do
      true -> P.mk(a)
      _ -> P.mk(1)
    end
    dbg(P.run(f, 10))
  end

WORK: re-home the containment witness on that dynamic shape (a _dynamic twin
beside the existing fixture, or rewrite the existing one), keep the Elixir
oracle, and re-run the fz-kdt.167 overlap-swap experiment against it to confirm
the swap is still caught (interp 12.0 / JIT abort). Then decide whether the
static fixture still earns its place -- it now pins 'this program asks nothing',
which is fz-kdt.127's law, not fz-kdt.167's.
title: callable_union_capture_containment stops asking its question under the type-preserving forwarder key: fz-kdt.167's end-to-end witness is now answered statically
